title: Independent Damage Tuning source and native semantics review
result: No blocking finding in the reviewed one-shot coefficient contract.
scope: Read-only review of product source, its actual included Combat helpers, catalog, test source and existing complete native ASM. No live game or additional IDA export; tests were read, not rerun by this reviewer.

verified.subject: Target and allocation lifetime
verified.detail: Each request resolves current player/status and, for target edits, manual lock-on. It requires matching backlinks, active actor list membership, a live aligned 632-byte record in the 80-entry pool and absence from the validated free list. Scene transition, Drive transition, native menu, stale heartbeat and foreign thread reject writes. No retained actor/status pointer or callback is used.

verified.subject: Mutation width and ownership
verified.detail: Slots272..285 map to exactly one byte at STATUS+424..430. Values must be integral0..255, and the exact byte must be writable. It is a one-time runtime change; Tick/Reset do not repeat or restore it. Slots286..293 remain read-only.

verified.subject: Test source
verified.detail: The harness includes production CombatFeatures.inl and DamageTuningFeatures.inl, verifies all fourteen slots and endpoints, adjacent-byte preservation, allocation/free-list consistency, lock-on identity, read-only page protection, phase/thread/heartbeat/Drive gates and capability boundaries. This review does not independently claim the author run count.

claims.Finding: At0x1403C143F..0x1403C1476 the normal damage path multiplies target STATUS[424+element] by STATUS[430], attack power and the earlier clamped base. STATUS+408/+412 belong to source cap/floor, +416/+420 to target cap/floor. Healing attack types5/6 branch at0x1403C13CF before coefficient multiplication. Difficulty, special-mode, Anti and ability modifications occur afterwards.
claims.Limitations: These are received-hit coefficients, not final HP-delta multipliers; integer rounding and later modifiers remain. Arithmetic uses32-bit intermediates, so arbitrary modified attack data can overflow.

claims.Finding: The target actor resolved from Hit+20 supplies STATUS to the damage calculator at0x1403CE86A..0x1403CE8A2. A zero product of the same coefficients sets Hit+24 bit4 and clears Hit+38 at0x1403CE8B4..0x1403CE8D6; zero is therefore more than a numeric damage scale.
claims.Limitations: The exact visible reaction depends on downstream consumers; the catalog correctly describes suppression of a native hit response without claiming total invulnerability.

claims.Finding: Instructions0x1403C25CB..0x1403C260B copy low bytes from EnemyParam+72,+74,+76,+78,+80,+82,+84 into STATUS+424..430 in order. This supports the catalog field layout.
claims.Limitations: Element names are inherited from the existing OpenKH field mapping and parent research; this review independently checked native order, not the external documentation again.

claims.Finding: The full body writes HP/MP-related save bytes, timer bytes and Drive-related fields; it does not persist STATUS+424..430.
claims.Limitations: This is a statement about this save-back body, not proof that changed combat outcomes cannot affect progression.

limitations: The reviewed native ASM is an existing complete export, not new independent extraction. Instruction count/completeness records were inspected.
No live game validation. Synthetic guards cannot establish all game or third-party-mod concurrency properties.

Pool address plus current backlink/free-list membership prevents ordinary stale-record use; an exact same-frame ABA with all identity fields reused is not independently detectable. No engine calls or waits occur between resolution and the single byte write.
ChangesProgression=false describes absence of a direct save/config edit. Changed combat outcomes may naturally affect rewards and progression.
